summary: Trailer lookout listed as Carracas (Cedar Rock), Rio Arriba County, NM; listed gone; a map-reprint description names a Cedar Rock Lookout; no source describes remains.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no date or cause given

events.note: A map-reprint site describes a USGS topographic map of Bancos Mesa, labeled 1995 and published 1997, as showing a Cedar Rock Lookout among its landmarks; the map itself was not seen

evidence.supports: listed as a trailer type, gone, in Rio Arriba County
evidence.quote: Carracas (Cedar Rock) Rio Arriba 36.95570 -107.25320 Trailer Gone

evidence.supports: Rio Arriba County, Carson National Forest
evidence.quote: New Mexico - Rio Arriba County - Carson National Forest

evidence.supports: the Cedar Rock name is used for a fire on the Jicarilla Ranger District (2023)

evidence.supports: the 2023 fire lay north of Forest Road 218 (Carracas Mesa Road)
evidence.quote: located north of Forest Road 218 (Carracas Mesa Road)

evidence.quote: Distinctive landmarks like Pecho de la Doncella and Cedar Rock Lookout provide prominent orientation points

evidence.supports: the 2023 fire was lightning-caused and estimated at 4 to 5 acres
evidence.quote: The estimated 4- to 5-acre lightning-caused fire is located north of Forest Road 218 (Carracas Mesa Road)

notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts Carracas page carries only a header, so the only lookout-specific facts are the listing's type and status. The Cedar Rock Lookout label comes from a reprint site's wording about a USGS map we did not see; the label may not match the map exactly. The 2023 Cedar Rock Fire is a different event and is mentioned only to explain the place name. The brief's record (Carson NF, mobile, gone) checks out. No build date, staffing or fire history was found.
